_help: How the Lore pages are organised. Each group is a heading on the Lore page; each article is one page (lore.html?a=<slug>). An article is built from one or more parts: {"tab": "Doc tab name"} takes the whole tab, adding "section": "Heading" takes just that section of the tab, {"special": "teams"} and {"special": "civilians"} build the team and civilian directories from data/people.json. characterTabs are left out of Lore because each character has a wiki profile. Doc tabs not used anywhere here appear under 'More from the story' so nothing new is lost after a refresh.
